children: Central Retail Corp.'s same-store sales are likely turning positive in 3Q after contracting in 1Q and 2Q, says Pattadol Bunnak at ttb wealth securities. Its same-store sales have grown about 2% so far in 3Q, driven by new product realignments and selections across its business lines, the analyst says. The Thai company's department store business has seen the biggest turnaround via adjustments to brands and products and renovations to store layouts. Central Retail Corp.'s same-store-sales should grow 2.3% in 3Q versus 1% contraction in 1H, the analyst estimates. The brokerage raises the stock's target price to 36.00 baht from THB31.00 with an unchanged buy rating. Shares are 0.9% higher at THB28.25. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
